title: Serves the purpose but hard to open
text: Serves the purpose but hard to open. I really like having something made specifically for coffee and where I don’t have to dig for the scooper. But when you unlock the closer it is very hard to open the lid and the tab pops off every time. Not sure if anyone else has this issue?

product_metadata.title: Progressive International PKS-600 1.5-Quart Plastic Coffee ProKeeper Storage Container with Scoop, Tinted
features: KEEPS COFFEE FRESH: Countertop coffee container that's ideal for storing and preserving freshness for a long time
LARGE CAPACITY: Can hold up to 1.5 quarts of coffee grounds or coffee beans
SILICONE SEAL: Designed with a silicone seal for air-tight storage and is made from UV-blocking plastic that helps preserve the coffee's flavor
AIRTIGHT SEAL: Easy-catch latch holds the lid tight, creating an airtight seal
INCLUDES A SCOOP: Comes with a 1-tablespoon scoop that conveniently snaps to the container
description: The PrepWorks by Progressive Coffee ProKeeper storage container combines high quality construction with a silicone seal for air-tight storage. The tinted UV-blocking plastic preserves the bold flavors of coffee beans and grounds for lasting fresh taste. The 1. 5-quart storage container includes a 1 tablespoon scoop which snaps conveniently inside the lid for easy storage and also has an easy-catch latch that holds the lid tightly closed. The patent pending stainless steel hinges swing wide open for no-fuss access to fill or measure and will fit into the dishwasher for easy care.
